records.reason: Two alembic environment scripts carry the same repository-authored rationale for silencing `alembic.runtime.plugins` before logging is configured. It is not alembic's generated text: it names this deployment's non-JSON-log constraint. Zero scaffolding, so the whole overlap is narrative saying one thing.

records.reason: `setup()` on four Postgres savers, all subclasses of `BasePostgresSaver`.
